title: Different answers can preserve closeness

captions.physics: Explaining the personal meaning of answers

meaning: By thoughtfully explaining different answers, you can preserve closeness through willing participation in conversation without requiring identical impressions.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Hermit in the physical position helps you speak from considered personal experience, explaining an answer rather than merely stating it. The Lovers in energy support a wish to meet willingly in conversation, with interest in each other’s genuine choices. The Lovers in emotions have a different role: feeling close when that interest is present. Wanting to participate and experiencing connection can support each other even when your opinions differ.

For example, after a film you ask each other whether you liked the ending. One answer may be enthusiastic and another restrained; you explain what you saw in the final scene. **Closeness does not require identical impressions**. You can hear why different things mattered and remain participants in the same conversation. Your considered words do not have to persuade. They let you see the personal meaning of an answer without turning the discussion into a test of how well you suit each other.

Difficulty appears if a developed explanation begins to sound like an argument for the only correct feeling. Disagreement may then feel like distance, although it concerns an impression. The constructive wish for mutual participation helps preserve freedom in the answer: you can understand its meaning without sharing the judgement. Closeness finds support in a difference that has been heard, as well as in saying “Me too”.
